entries.claim: This dependent same-recension digital comparison supplies the explicitly resolved Latin reading; it does not establish independent transmission or another printed edition.

This opening page of the approved Benziger printing supplies the Easter Preface from Vere dignum through praedicare (w001–w020), with the rubric prescribing in hac potissimum nocte for the Easter Vigil. The continuation on p. 237 is bound separately; the preceding dialogue is outside this text.

This continuation page of the approved Benziger printing supplies the Easter Preface from cum Pascha nostrum through sine fine dicentes (w021-w066). The following Sanctus and Infra Actionem directions are outside the selected preface body.
